Gandhis challenge ED plea in National Herald money laundering case

Sonia Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi have stated that the Enforcement Directorate's (ED) appeal in the Delhi High Court is an "abuse of the process of law." The ED had challenged a trial court order that refused to take cognisance of its chargesheet against them in the National Herald-linked money laundering case. The Gandhis claim the ED registered an ECIR against them based on a private complaint, alleging "extraneous considerations."
